relevance_note: Single case report of a man with a LAMP2 variant: "heterozygous for a novel frameshift mutation in the LAMP2 gene, thus confirming the diagnosis of Danon disease".
method_note: Hand extraction from a short case report (no tables); the JSON was assembled with a small Python script and every span was checked verbatim by script. Only the index patient is in scope. His mother ('His mother had died of unknown etiology at age 40') and father are mentioned but neither tested nor described as affected, so they get no rows. The variant itself is not printed (only 'a novel frameshift mutation in the LAMP2 gene'), so variant_original_string is 'not reported'. Zygosity recorded as stated ('heterozygous') even though the patient is male; possible inconsistency for an X-linked gene, recorded verbatim and flagged here. Possible tension: ECG showed short PR / WPW pre-excitation pattern, but the electrophysiologic study 'failed to demonstrate any evidence of accessory pathways'; pre-excitation kept as observed (ECG finding), accessory pathway recorded as excluded. Biopsy of the RV septum showed 'no fibrosis', while CMR showed diffuse LGE with 63% scar burden; both recorded as stated (different methods/sites). Heart failure left 'not reported' on the checklist: the paper mentions only 'optimal heart failure medications', not a heart-failure diagnosis. 'Mild limb muscle weakness' taken as observed skeletal myopathy for the composite checklist item (proximal not specified). Age at onset not recorded: the paper gives a '7-year history' (duration), not an age. Year of publication not printed in the text, so null. Pathogenicity left 'not reported': the paper says only 'novel frameshift mutation'.
